name: Tesseract Robot Artifact
description: Build an exact content-addressed Tesseract artifact from URDF/SRDF and local package roots. KDL, collision-mesh, and contact-manager selections remain explicit and become part of the artifact identity.

inputParameters.name: robot_cell
inputParameters.description: RobotCell loaded from the same exact URDF/SRDF; used to validate group chains.

inputParameters.name: urdf_filename
inputParameters.description: Absolute path to the exact UTF-8 URDF file.

inputParameters.name: srdf_filename
inputParameters.description: Absolute path to the exact UTF-8 SRDF file.

inputParameters.name: resource_roots
inputParameters.description: Directories whose immediate children are package:// package directories. Every file in each referenced package is retained.

inputParameters.name: planning_groups
inputParameters.description: Groups receiving KDL plugins. Defaults to robot_cell.main_group_name.

inputParameters.name: collision_mesh_policy
inputParameters.description: preserve or convex_hull. Explicitly controls Tesseract collision-mesh conversion; defaults to convex_hull.

inputParameters.name: inverse_kinematics
inputParameters.description: kdl_lma or kdl_newton_raphson. Defaults to kdl_lma.

inputParameters.name: discrete_contact_manager
inputParameters.description: bullet_bvh, bullet_simple, or fcl_bvh. Defaults to bullet_bvh.

inputParameters.name: continuous_contact_manager
inputParameters.description: bullet_cast_bvh or bullet_cast_simple. Defaults to bullet_cast_bvh.

outputParameters.name: artifact
outputParameters.description: Exact RobotArtifact. Retain or inspect this object; it is never reduced to a COMPAS-only projection.

outputParameters.name: artifact_id
outputParameters.description: SHA-256 build identity covering descriptions, package resources, generated plugins, and component versions.
